translation: Not poisonous. Its chief actions are to dispel water qi within the lungs, stop spitting of blood, heat-thirst, edema, abdominal fullness, dropsy distension (臚脹), benefit the waterway, dispel tapeworms (寸白), and [treat] wounds. Gather without a fixed time; that which emerges above the soil kills a person.
translator_notes: 出土上者殺人: the root part that comes out of the ground is toxic.
